entries.text: KC McClure was the Chief Financial Officer of Accenture (a global professional services company offering consulting and technology services) from January 2019 until November 2024 and retired as Senior Finance Advisor in March 2025. Throughout Ms. McClure’s more than 37-year tenure at Accenture, Ms. McClure held multiple finance and accounting leadership roles, including Managing Director, Finance Operation from June 2018 to January 2019, Finance Director - Communications, Media & Technology Group from December 2016 to May 2018, Head of Investor Relations from September 2010 to November 2016, and Finance Director - Health and Public Services from March 2002 to August 2010. Earlier in her career, Ms. McClure also served in a variety of finance roles with Accenture’s new business ventures, alliances and outsourcing teams. Ms. McClure serves on the board of The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. and serves as a member on the Smeal College of Business Board of Visitors. She holds a Bachelor of Science degree in accounting and business administration from Pennsylvania State University’s Smeal College of Business.

Throughout Ms. McClure’s more than 37-year tenure at Accenture, Ms. McClure held multiple finance and accounting leadership roles, including Managing Director, Finance Operation from June 2018 to January 2019, Finance Director - Communications, Media & Technology Group from December 2016 to May 2018, Head of Investor Relations from September 2010 to November 2016, and Finance Director - Health and Public Services from March 2002 to August 2010. Earlier in her career, Ms. McClure also served in a variety of finance roles with Accenture’s new business ventures, alliances and outsourcing teams. Ms. McClure serves on the board of The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. and serves as a member on the Smeal College of Business Board of Visitors. She holds a Bachelor of Science degree in accounting and business administration from Pennsylvania State University’s Smeal College of Business.
